name: My Heart Becomes Ice Cream
source:
“My Heart Becomes Ice Cream” is a very short kinetic novel (probably about two minutes in length) that begins thus: “I have an apartment in Astoria with huge windows."

[From [url=http://lunasspecto.wordpress.com/visual-novels/]lunas specto[/url]]
